notes.title: ver0.1.9 - Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Additions[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added “Difficulty 3” to each stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a “Lock” feature to the shop.[/p][list][*][p]Locked items will continue to appear in future shop visits.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Overall adjustments to weapon evolution effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Overall adjustments to artifact effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added possession limits for each artifact.[/p][list][*][p]Artifacts that have reached their limit will no longer appear as options.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that normal enemies also spawn when elite enemies appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that after a boss enemy appears, a large number of enemies spawn alongside enemy enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Added display of remaining ammo and reload status above the character’s head.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted status ailment descriptions to provide more detailed information.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the maximum armor value for characters to “70.”[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the maximum dodge rate for characters to “70%.”[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted localization for various texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed garbled text issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where “Reroll” would not appear when evolving a weapon in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visibility of damage number texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.8 - Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted character selection and deployment behavior when using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could spawn outside the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapons that had already reached max level could still appear as level-up options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where slimes could be unintentionally destroyed at the start of a stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.7 - Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added detailed effect descriptions to each status ailment.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted to make it clear when effect duration increases upon acquiring duplicate status effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some character and weapon stats displayed during pause were incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the level-up option for "Fish Bullet" was not displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.6 - Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted the stats and effects of the "Bow" weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added object indicators such as "Treasure Chests" to the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that chickens drop a certain amount of crystals.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted so that when maximum HP increases, the same amount of HP is gained.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the spawn rate of mission-related objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Made minor stat adjustments to some weapons.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an error would occur when upgrading to the maximum level using the enhancement feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where artifacts would sometimes not drop after defeating a floor boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ver0.1.5 - Update
notes.content: [h2][b]Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Supports mouse controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Start" button to the character selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the prices of some cards in the "Card Shop".[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where increases in "Pickup Range" were not being applied correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the effects of equipped "Cards" were not being applied properly.[/p][/*][/list]
